subjective: Patient twisted ankle playing basketball two days ago. Reports swelling and pain with weight-bearing, localized to the lateral ankle.
objective: Swelling and bruising over the lateral ankle. Full range of motion without bony tenderness. Able to bear weight and ambulate.
assessment: Mild lateral ankle sprain. Low suspicion for fracture; X-ray not indicated at this time.
plan: RICE protocol (rest, ice, compression, elevation). Over-the-counter ibuprofen as needed for pain. Return in 1 week if not improving, or sooner if worsening, for possible X-ray.
